title: A Hurewicz Theorem for $RO(C_2)$-graded Equivariant Homology Governed by Vector Fields on Spheres
summary: We determine the $RO(C_2)$-graded Hurewicz images of the $C_2$-equivariant Eilenberg--MacLane spectra $H\underline{\mathbb F_2}$, $H\underline{\mathbb Z}$ and $H\underline{A}$, where $\underline{\mathbb F_2}$ and $\underline{\mathbb Z}$ denote the constant Mackey functors with values in $\mathbb F_2$ and $\mathbb Z$, respectively, and $\underline A$ denotes the Burnside Mackey functor.
